description: Make an eligible finished product video again. quality best, the default, uses the current model: Wan 3.0, or Seedance 2.5 when Wan 3.0 is not offered. quality seedance25 selects Seedance 2.5 explicitly. It uses the video's own script, photos and choices to make a new product video beside it. The app offers the same model choices. This spends the team's credits: the price listed for the selected quality in after_steps.remake_product_video.choices from get_product_video. For the default best, the legacy after_steps.make_in_best price also applies. The step is refunded if it fails. Only for a video whose after_steps offers that remake. Answers an id at once: call get_product_video with it about once a minute until its status is ready or failed.

credits.description: The credits listed for the selected quality in after_steps.remake_product_video.choices, or after_steps.make_in_best for default best; a different figure is refused.

id.description: The id of a finished product video, from make_product_video.

idempotency_key.description: Any string unique to this video. Calling again with the same key and the same arguments answers as the first call did and spends nothing more.

quality.description: best by default, or seedance25 for Seedance 2.5. Each quality's current quote is listed in after_steps.remake_product_video.choices.

name: remake_product_video
title: Remake the product video
